name: kkmovies
description: KKMovies - Catalogo de filmes e series com metadados TMDB e player unico

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build
scripts.deploy:help: node -e "console.log('Consulte README.md para configuracao e publicacao.')"
scripts.check: npm run build:backend && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json && node --test backend/tests/*.test.cjs && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false

author: Kauan
